verdict.rationale: Adyen sends a relayed authorisation webhook carrying "relevant transaction data, including transaction rules and validation checks" for real-time decisioning, so authorization events do carry some context. The evidence never details which fields that payload contains. Missing for 10: documented merchant name and MCC fields, enhanced merchant data, wallet/token and POS entry-mode details in the auth payload, partial-approval and incremental-authorization signals, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
